ios-safari: On iPhone and iPad, Safari itself installs the app, in 3 taps:
Tap Share (the square with the little arrow ⬆️), in the bottom or top bar.
Scroll the list and tap Add to Home Screen.
Confirm with Add, in the top corner. The Mestre Solar sun appears on your screen.
If you can't find the option, tap Edit Actions at the end of the list and turn on Add to Home Screen.
ios-outro: On iPhone and iPad, the app is installed from the Share menu:
Tap Share ⬆️ (in Chrome it is next to the address; or in the ⋯ menu).
If the option doesn't appear, open this address in Safari and follow the same steps.
ios-firefox: If the option doesn't appear, open this address in Safari and follow the same steps.
ios-embutido: You opened the link inside another app, and it doesn't allow installing. Do this:
Tap the ⋯ menu and choose Open in Safari (or Open in browser).
Tap Add to Home Screen and then Add.
mac-safari: In Safari on the Mac, Mestre Solar becomes an app in the Dock:
Click Add. The sun appears in the Dock and in Launchpad.
You can also use the Share button ⬆️ → Add to Dock.
mac-safari-antigo: Your Mac's Safari is older than version 17 and can't install web apps yet.
Update macOS (Safari 17 or newer) and use File → Add to Dock,
or open this address in Chrome or Edge and tap the sun again.
android-firefox: Tap Install (in some versions: Add to Home screen).
Firefox doesn't let the app open the installation itself, so it is done from the menu. In Chrome it takes a single tap.
pc-firefox: Firefox for desktop doesn't install web apps the way Chrome and Edge do.
Click the Install sun again: installation happens right away.
You can also save the address in your Firefox bookmarks.
android-embutido: You opened the link inside another app, and it doesn't allow installing. Do this:
Tap the ⋮ menu and choose Open in Chrome (or Open in browser).
In Chrome, tap the Install sun again.
android-samsung: Tap the ☰ menu, in the bottom bar.
Tap Add page to → Home screen (or the ⬇️ icon next to the address).
android-chrome: The browser is still preparing the installation. If nothing appears in a few seconds:
Tap the ⋮ menu (three dots), at the top.
If you already installed it, look for the Mestre Solar sun among your apps.
pc-chrome: The browser is still preparing the installation. If nothing appears in a few seconds:
In Chrome: click the install icon ⊕ in the address bar, or the ⋮ menu → Cast, save and share → Install page as app.
In Edge: ⋯ menu → Apps → Install this site as an app.
If you already installed it, look for Mestre Solar among your apps.
